items: BEAUTIFUL AND ORGANIZED - Make your kids playroom space neat and organized with this toy storage organizer with bookshelf and 12 white bins; Shelf Size: 52.3"W x 13.6"D x 31.5"H

MODERN AND STYLISH - With solid pine wood construction, these toy organizers and storage boxes bring modern to any home decor; Perfect kids bookcase and toy storage for bedrooms, living rooms, nursery and playrooms
THOUGHTFUL DESIGN - The kids toy storage shelf features smooth, rounded edges in playroom organization; Its front extended base deisgn provides stability to prevent tipping and wobbling
EASY TO ASSEMBLE - It is super easy to put the toy bin storage rack together; You can assemble easily with the included instructions; And it won't take up too much of your time
